bootstrap.source: pinned official OpenSCAD snapshots with checked-in SHA-256 digests
bootstrap.tested: fake-download/checksum/extraction tests plus manual Linux x86_64 probe and Bin/Baseplate renders with the pinned artifact; other hosts remain host-dependent

runtime.resolution: OrcaSlicer's bundled uv resolves the Python runtime dependencies on the first Code-mode CAD operation; the Pages plugin probes OpenSCAD at startup and silently provisions the pinned per-user build when a supported system executable is unavailable.

orcaslicer.tested_build: Nightly exposing the main-branch Pages API

stable_2_4_2.reason: The stable 2.4.2 build has no orca.pages API.

orcaslicer.other_builds: Not claimed unless the required Pages API and bridge behavior are present.
orcaslicer.unsupported_behavior: Without orca.pages the plugin registers an upgrade-hint Script capability instead of a CAD tab.

operating_systems.status: The plugin uses the host API and has platform-specific open/gio/xdg-open handoff paths, but non-Linux hosts are expected rather than verified in this checkout.

matrix.name: pure Python tests
matrix.scope: No build123d/OCP; CAD modules skip when run outside the project virtualenv.

matrix.name: frontend tests and build
matrix.command: cd frontend && npm test && npm run build
matrix.scope: Uses the locked npm dependency tree; Node/npm are contributor-only.

matrix.name: bundle synchronization
matrix.scope: Checks generated specs, the compiled page fingerprint, and the embedded page/backend archive.

matrix.name: geometry integration
matrix.scope: Uses .venv with the declared build123d/OCP versions; skips with repair guidance when absent.
